name: CUMYL-PINACA
summary: CUMYL-PINACA (also known as SGT-24) is an indazole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid.41nM for human CB2 receptors. In its pure form, it is described as a sticky oil which can cause poisoning through transdermal exposure. It has been detected as an extract of organic material by CanTEST in June 2026.

pharmacology.text: CUMYL-PINACA acts as a potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with approximately 3x selectivity for CB1, having an EC50 of 0.15nM for human CB1 receptors and 0.41nM for human CB2 receptors.

summaryZh: CUMYL-PINACA（開發代號：SGT-24）是一種有機化合物，化學式為C22H27N3O，屬於吲唑-3-甲醯胺類合成大麻素。
summaryZhHans: CUMYL-PINACA（开发代号：SGT-24）是一种有机化合物，化学式为C22H27N3O，属于吲唑-3-甲酰胺类合成大麻素。

uses.en: It has been sold as a designer drug in synthetic cannabis products. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾以設計師藥物的形式出現在合成大麻產品中，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾以设计师药物的形式出现在合成大麻产品中，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it from controlled studies in people. In pure form it is a sticky oil that can cause poisoning through the skin. Synthetic cannabinoids like it can cause a racing heart, anxiety, paranoia, vomiting, psychosis and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前缺乏人體對照研究的資料。純品是一種黏稠的油，可能經由皮膚吸收而中毒。這類合成大麻素可能造成心跳過快、焦慮、妄想、嘔吐、精神病症狀與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前缺乏人体对照研究的数据。纯品是一种黏稠的油，可能经由皮肤吸收而中毒。这类合成大麻素可能造成心跳过快、焦虑、妄想、呕吐、精神病症状与癫痫发作。

fact.en: Synthetic cannabinoid names are built from their parts. PINACA stands for a pentyl tail, an indazole core and a carboxamide link.
fact.zh: 合成大麻素的名稱是由其結構組合而成。PINACA 代表戊基尾巴、吲唑核心與甲醯胺連接。
fact.zhHans: 合成大麻素的名称是由其结构组合而成。PINACA 代表戊基尾巴、吲唑内核与甲酰胺连接。
